subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land the fresh-session recook fallback for accepted non-transient gateway disconnects now, or wait for the reattach-first design tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The patch fixes same-session transcript duplication, but it intentionally preserves the existing timeout-style behavior where a detached gateway run and a local fallback run may both execute.

options.title: Land focused mitigation now
options.body: Merge after branch refresh and checks, explicitly accepting the existing two-run fallback boundary while keeping the reattach-first issue open.

options.title: Extend to reattach-first first
options.body: Hold this PR and make accepted disconnects wait for the gateway run before using fresh-session fallback as the last resort.

options.title: Pause as product-risky
options.body: Leave the PR open or close it if maintainers decide the rare duplicate-session bug should not be fixed without the larger recovery redesign.

recommendation.title: Land focused mitigation now
recommendation.body: Merge after branch refresh and checks, explicitly accepting the existing two-run fallback boundary while keeping the reattach-first issue open.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger introduced the gateway CLI path and is the strongest history signal for the user-facing CLI fallback behavior choice.
